description: This file defines a database migration class for version 4.2 of the OrangeHRM software. It extends an abstract migration class and includes methods to add columns, create menu items, insert permissions, and manage schema updates related to maintenance and data purge functionalities.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Represents a database schema migration for OrangeHRM version 4.2, handling schema updates and menu/permission setup.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the database schema changes and inserts required menu items and permissions during migration.

methods.name: insertMenuItems
methods.description: Helper method to insert a menu item into the database with specified properties.

methods.name: getScreenId
methods.description: Retrieves the screen ID associated with a given action URL from the database.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version identifier for this migration, which is '4.2'.
